sentences.text: Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. R A CHOUDHURY Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM

BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MRIDUL KUMAR KALITA  ORDER 17.11.2023 Heard Mr. T.J. Mahanta, learned Senior Counsel, assisted by Mr. R.A. Mazumder,
learned counsel for the petitioner. Also heard Ms. A. Begum, learned Page No.# 2/4 Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam.

This application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed by the petitioner, namely, Sukkur Uddin, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Ramnathpur P.S. Case No. 132/2023 under Section 120B/406/409/420 of the Indian Penal Code corresponding Sukkur Uddin vs The State Of Assam on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74218466/
1 to GR Case No. 922/2023.
The gist of accusation in this case is that on 23.08.2023, one Sri P. Dowerah, Block Development Officer, South Hailakandi Development Block, Hailakandi lodged an FIR before the Officer-In-Charge of Ramnathpur Police Station, inter-alia, alleging that the present petitioner, who was the then In- Charge of Gaon Panchayat Secretary of Baldabaldi-Nandagram GP and one Ashok Kr. Nunia, the then Executive Engineer of said G.P. has misappropriated funds under 14th Finance Commission Grant of Baldabaldi-Nandagram as found in the inquiry report received from the Commissioner, Panchayat & Rural Development, Assam.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the basis of the said FIR, Ramnathpur P.S. Case No. 132/2023 was registered.

Learned Senior Counel for the petitioner submits that the FIR has been registered on the basis of an inquiry report submitted by Assistant Development Commissioner and Assistant Engineer regarding alleged anomalies in implementation of 14th Finance Commission Scheme in Baldabaldi-Nandagram GP of South Hailakandi Development Block, Hailakandi.

It is submitted by the learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner that on perusal of the said inquiry report, it could be apparent that the findings of the same inquiry report directly implicate, the President of the GP, namely Rushma Begum Mazumdar and her husband Abdul Kalam Mazumdar and only in the inquiry report an inference has been made that the present petitioner may also Page No.# 3/4 be involved.
However, no basis for such reference is there in the inquiry report.

Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner has also submitted that the petitioner was working as the In-Charge Secretary of the Baldabaldi-Nandagram Gaon Panchayat on 09.01.2020 and he remained as such till 10.09.2020, when he was promoted to the post of Assistant Development.

Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that the inquiry report shows that the alleged misappropriation of funds had occurred prior to the period when the present petitioner functioned as In-charge Secretary of Baldabaldi-Nandagram Gaon Panchayat.

Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner has also submitted that presently the petitioner is posted as an Assistant Block Development Officer at Katlicherra Devlopment Block, Hailakandi and he is ready to co-operate in the investigation.

On the other hand, learned Additional Public Prosecutor opposes the grant of bail to the present petitioner on the ground that this case involves huge misappropriation of public funds and she further submits that perusal of the case diary would be necessary for consideration of the instant bail application.
Hence, call for the case diary, fixing 14.12.2023.

However, considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioner and considering the inquiry report which has been placed before this Court, along with the bail application as well as considering the fact that the petitoner is ready to co-operate in the investigation, the present petitioner, namely, Sukkur Uddin, is hereby directed to appear before the Investigating Officer of Ramnathpur P.S. Case No. 132/2023 within 10(ten)
Sukkur Uddin vs The State Of Assam on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74218466/

entities.text: Sukkur Uddin vs The State Of Assam
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2 days from the date of this order and co-operate in the investigation.

If he does so, within the stipulated period of time, in the event of his arrest in connection with Page No.# 4/4 Ramnathpur P.S. Case No. 132/2023, the above named petitioner shall be allowed to go on interim bail of Rs.
30,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject to the conditions that:-
(i) the petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when so required by the Investigating Officer for the sake of fair investigation and shall co-operate in investigation; and (ii) the petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement threat or promise to any other persons who may be acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade such person from disclosing such facts before the Investigating Officer or to any Court;
Let this case be fixed again on 14.12.2023.
